name: Bear on Boat
summary:
# Bear on Boat is exactly what it sounds like.

You are a **bear**.
You are on a **boat**.
You are **fishing**.

Flee your responsibilities and cast your line, catch fish (and some other weird things), and look upon the fact that you are, undeniably, a **bear on a boat**.
 
# GOTTA CATCH 'EM ALL

Unlock new photos on your fishbook by catching all 32 fishes (well, it's actually not the fishes)!
